content.title: Word: Blue - Meaning, Usage, Idioms & Fun Facts
content.text: Basic Details Word: Blue Part of Speech: Adjective Meaning: A colour that resembles the sky or the sea, often associated with calmness and sadness. Synonyms: Azure, cobalt, cerulean Antonyms: Red, orange, yellow Idioms and Phrases Feeling blue: To feel sad or depressed. Example: "After his friend moved away, he was feeling blue for several weeks." Out of the blue: Something that happens unexpectedly. Example: "She received a letter from her old friend out of the blue, and it made her day." Usage Examples Example 1: The sky was a bright blue on the day of the picnic, making it perfect for outdoor fun. Example 2: He painted his room a soothing shade of blue to help him relax. Example 3: The blue whale is the largest animal on Earth, known for its incredible size and beauty. Fun Fact Did you know that blue is the second most preferred colour in the world? It is often associated with trust and peace, making it a popular choice for company logos and branding. Famous Quote "Blue is the only colour which maintains its own character in all its tones." - Henri Matisse Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) 1. What does "blue" refer to? a) A type of fruit b) A colour resembling the sky c) A kind of animal d) A dessert Answer: b) A colour resembling the sky 2. Which of these is a synonym of "blue"? a) Green b) Azure c) Black d) Pink Answer: b) Azure 3. Which sentence uses "blue" correctly? a) The blue cat climbed the tree. b) The blue sky was filled with birds. c) Blue is my favourite animal. d) The blue jumped over the fence. Answer: b) The blue sky was filled with birds. 4. Which idiom means to feel sad? a) Out of the blue b) Feeling blue c) Blue moon d) Like a fish out of water Answer: b) Feeling blue 5. What is the opposite of "blue"? a) Green b) Red c) Blue is neutral d) Violet Answer: b) Red
